about: Read by tools/check_ui_texts.py (S10c, B1). Each group is one reason why a string literal with a letter under src/ui/angulo is NOT text the panel draws. An entry is a file and the decoded literal; it covers every occurrence there. What the panel draws is never listed, even when it reads the same in every language: it goes through UA_TXT( ). An entry that matches nothing is a finding.

groups.reason: the brand: SIMUT is the product's name, the same in every language
a unit: a symbol that reads the same in every language (the degree Celsius, hPa, h, min)
a format string with no word: only conversions, punctuation and the unit symbols kB, dBm, s and °C; the words it joins are texts of their own
an icon name: a key of the kit's icon table (kit/icones/icones.h), looked up by name and never drawn as text
an identifier passed to another API: the language tags the settings store (pt-BR, es-ES) and the theme ids that /api/ui and the theme catalogue carry (claro, escuro-azul, ...); never drawn
a name compared with what the user typed, never drawn: the reserved account name

the bench endpoint GET /api/ui (src/ui/angulo/WebManager_UiA.cpp, which only the two Ângulo images compile, pico_wiretft_angulo and pico2_w_angulo): its route, headers, content type, JSON keys and error strings are read by the bench scripts and never drawn

groups.reason: a linker section: the attribute that places a function in RAM and the name it is placed under, read by tools/check_ui_ram.py
a host-harness tag: the kind of control passed to UA_CONTROLE( ) and the name of the screen passed to conferirCaixas( ), which the host tests read and the firmware compiles out
a host-harness diagnostic: written to stderr by the host tests (UA_HOST) when a sample is wrong; it is not on the firmware and never drawn
